using System;using System.IO;using System.Linq;using ACadSharp;using ACadSharp.IO;using ACadSharp.Entities;using ACadSharp.Tables;using CSMath;
class Program{
 static Hatch.BoundaryPath Ring(double x1,double y1,double x2,double y2,bool hole=false){var points=new[]{new XY(x1,y1),new XY(x2,y1),new XY(x2,y2),new XY(x1,y2)};if(hole)Array.Reverse(points);var path=new Hatch.BoundaryPath();for(int i=0;i<4;i++)path.Edges.Add(new Hatch.BoundaryPath.Line{Start=points[i],End=points[(i+1)%4]});return path;}
 static Hatch Area(double x1,double y1,double x2,double y2,bool patterned=false,double[] hole=null){var h=new Hatch{IsSolid=!patterned};h.Paths.Add(Ring(x1,y1,x2,y2));if(hole!=null)h.Paths.Add(Ring(hole[0],hole[1],hole[2],hole[3],true));if(patterned){h.Pattern=new HatchPattern("ANSI31");h.Pattern.Lines.Add(new HatchPattern.Line{Angle=Math.PI/4,BasePoint=new XY(),Offset=new XY(-1,1)});}return h;}
 static void Main(string[] args){System.Text.Encoding.RegisterProvider(System.Text.CodePagesEncodingProvider.Instance);var dir=args[0];var doc=new CadDocument();doc.Header.ModelSpaceInsertionBase=new XYZ(10,20,0);var a=new Layer("Hatched areas"){Color=new Color(2)};var b=new Layer("Patterned areas"){Color=new Color(4)};doc.Layers.Add(a);doc.Layers.Add(b);var solid=Area(12,23,18,29,hole:new[]{14d,25,16,27});solid.Layer=a;doc.Entities.Add(solid);var patterned=Area(20,23,26,29,true);patterned.Layer=b;doc.Entities.Add(patterned);DwgWriter.Write(Path.Combine(dir,"hatched.dwg"),doc);
 var expected=new CadDocument();expected.Entities.Add(Area(499973,7000004,499991,7000016,hole:new[]{499979d,7000008,499985,7000012}));expected.Entities.Add(Area(500102,7000003,500108,7000009,hole:new[]{500104d,7000005,500106,7000007}));expected.Entities.Add(Area(499973,7000020,499991,7000032));expected.Entities.Add(Area(500110,7000003,500116,7000009));DxfWriter.Write(Path.Combine(dir,"hatches-expected.dxf"),expected);
 }
}
